title: Thai Mushroom Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired pilaf dish made with mushrooms and served with a side of golden kissed dutch spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the kissed golden olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the mushroom and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the golden kissed dutch pilaf rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the dutch spices, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry for another minute.
5. Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
8. You can also add some chopped scallions or toasted nuts for added flavor and texture.
